versions.changelog:
- Initial release of trirank-geo-audit: static AI SEO readiness checker for any website.
- Fetches homepage, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt; checks indexability, metadata, structured data, and AI crawler access.
- Runs a detailed 14-point checklist with weighted scoring; outputs a scored gap report with concrete fixes for every failed or partial check.
- Clearly distinguishes between "AI readiness" (can be audited) and "AI citation status" (requires live testing; not measurable statically).
- Fully details transparent rules for honest auditing and report generation.
